invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new merged element constructed from parent or template, and never returns null.
The merged element uses the template's name unless template is null, in which case it uses parent's name.
The result is always a new element and is not the same object as parent or template unless one is null and directly returned.

invariants.expression: (template == null && result == parent) || (parent == null && result == template) || (parent != null && template != null && result.getName().equals(template.getName()))
invariants.rationale: When one argument is null, the other is returned directly. When both are non-null, result is a merged element with template's name.

invariants.expression: result.getAttributeCount() >= Math.max((parent != null ? parent.getAttributeCount() : 0), (template != null ? template.getAttributeCount() : 0))
invariants.rationale: All attributes from parent and template are present in the result (with overwrites), so the count should be at least as large as the max of theirs.
